item.title: PNG Barramundis set for ICC T20 World Cup EAP qualifier in Japan
item.description: Cricket Papua New Guinea (CPNG) has officially announced the PNG Barramundis squad for the upcoming ICC Men’s T20 World Cup East Asia-Pacific (EAP) Qualifier. The tournament is scheduled to take place in Japan from 8–18 May 2026.

item.title: ON THIS DAY IN OUR HISTORY: Worker and K13,000 go missing
item.description: A major Highlands company suffered a K13,000 theft on Saturday... and officials suspect 2 wis an "inside" job.

item.title: Community praises RSPCA’s free sterilisation effort
item.description: Pet owners across Port Moresby say RSPCA PNG’s free desexing service is easing household struggles, preventing unwanted litters, and helping control the city’s stray population, all at a time when normal services would charge more.

item.title: Vets beyond borders volunteers assist RSPCA in Port Moresby desexing drive
item.description: Australian veterinary professionals, coordinated through Vets Beyond Borders (VBB), have joined the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) PNG in Port Moresby to deliver free desexing procedures, aiming to reduce stray dog populations, prevent disease, and improve animal welfare.

item.title: Australia, PNG strengthen disaster preparedness partnership
item.description: A senior delegation from Australia’s National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) recently visited Papua New Guinea (15–20 March) to meet with key partners and stakeholders, and to ensure that both nations are better prepared, more resilient, and faster to respond when natural disasters strike.

item.title: Madang commemorates World TB Day and National Council of Women Day
item.description: Madang marked World Tuberculosis Day on March 24, 2026, under the theme “Yes! We Can End TB in PNG,” alongside celebrations of National Council of Women Day.

item.title: Alluvial Gold Mining sustains livelihoods along the Ok Tedi River
item.description: Alluvial mining along the Ok Tedi River remains a key source of income for communities in the North Fly District, with people of all ages relying on the activity to support their daily needs.

item.title: New law and justice partnership empowers Bougainville students
item.description: Bougainville’s students will gain new opportunities to learn about respect, safety, and justice through a pioneering partnership between schools and the law and justice sector. The program will help young people understand their rights and responsibilities, encourage positive behavior, and create safer schools, and an investment in Bougainville’s future.

item.title: Successful academy program relaunches under PNGRFL
item.description: The Papua New Guinea Rugby Football League (PNGRFL) is delighted to relaunch the highly successful PNG NRL Academy as the PNGRFL Academy, with the program coming under the management and oversight of the national governing body.

item.title: PC Online Tidbits
item.description: If the war in the Middle East escalates Trump won't have to worry about inflation anymore. It will be out of control at home and globally. It is not just fuel. There are gazillions of consumer goods that people may not realize use petrochemicals as inputs. Those include clothes, iPhones, candy, dentures, dishwashing liquid, footballs, shampoo, toothpaste, lipstick, plastic toys, trash bags, umbrellas, tires—you name it. PNG will not be immune to warflation!
